title: 読書の秋の動物たち
subject_en: Loose hand-drawn style animals reading books in cosy poses, each ONE animal with a book, centred, warm autumn colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 本を読む動物を、ゆるい手描きのタッチで描いた12点です。図書だよりや読書週間の案内、書店のポップに使えます。
items: a cat lying on its belly reading an open book
a dog sitting and holding a picture book with both paws
a rabbit sitting with a stack of books beside it, reading one
a bear in an armchair reading a thick book with round glasses
an owl on a branch with a small book and tiny glasses
a fox sitting under a tree reading with a scarf on
a squirrel hugging a large book with a fallen acorn beside
a panda reading a book while eating a bamboo shoot
a penguin carrying a tall stack of books
an elephant holding a tiny book with its trunk
a hedgehog reading a book with autumn leaves on its back
a tanuki sitting and reading a scroll-like book with a lantern
